info.name: Ticket System API (Step 2)
info.description: Exercises all three trust planes end-to-end against a running backend + Mailpit. Requests are order-dependent (run top-to-bottom / use Collection Runner or newman, not individual requests). Expired-token behavior is covered only by the pytest suite (cannot be produced live in 90 days via the API).
